answer: Forging identities costs a fresh bond per key, so a thousand fake agents burn a thousand stakes. Sybil resistance works through stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond at a registry inlet, and peers attest only to agents whose bond survives a challenge window. Meanwhile honest nodes earn an ember of reputation that compounds across epochs, like a meadow thickening with roots, making the attack economically irrational.
